editions.text:
The station logged 25 species on this day, above the past week's average of 21.7, with 20 heard and 14 seen. Feeder visits came to 119, quieter than the week's average of 171.9, while detections (245) stayed close to the usual 241.6. Eastern Towhee led the heard list with 54 detections, and Tufted Titmouse (15) and Northern Cardinal (12) led the visits.

Brown-headed Cowbird returned after 8 days away, last recorded October 31, and Cedar Waxwing returned after 7 days, last recorded November 1. Twelve species were recorded on all seven of the prior days and this day, including American Crow, Blue Jay, Carolina Chickadee, Eastern Towhee, and Northern Cardinal. Snow Goose was recorded on this day for the first time in the past week.

The heard counts came from several microphones, switching among c120, pi, and pi-mic (movo-dom1). No species was heard for the first time at the station, and no first confident visual record was made.
